preconditions: paper full PDF read in WSL
source force/independent energy correspondence PASS for complete family
pristine hash and independent enumeration PASS

ROI.selection: node center X in half-open interval, all Y and Z. Full node families include neighbors outside ROI; plane is infinite. Only node energies are windowed; no clipping of bonds at ROI edge.
ROI.nonzero_energy_nodes_reference_family_un: Both planes fit within z physical +/-0.5 mm; verified complete 122-neighbor stencil on potential influence band.

classification: lower side iff reference z < plane; equal assigned upper; exact original float64 coordinates; actual min distance >24 um; unique undirected crossing iff endpoints differ in side
two_sided: Sum all endpoint point energies on both sides once, each times Vi; divide by ONE projected ROI area. No extra factor 2.
m: Fixed full original m by atom ID; do not use alive masks
omega: 1/r0; additional consistent delta scaling diagnostic of same main state only
taper: exact saved original h, independently checked against source; no toggled-taper energy variants
ideal_extension: cross: s00*r0, noncross: 0, all original bonds retained in deviatoric sum; not global coordinates
sensitivity: ONE neighboring gap z=dx, same grid phase. Position/finite-height check only; not phase or mesh convergence.

gates.theory_discrete_agreement: NO arbitrary percentage gate; report actual difference

stop: Failure of identity, periodic/taper or energy definition stops certification; never change material/area to force agreement
